params.name: ClientID
params.description: 22-character <<glossary:ClientID>>. Ask [TabaPay Support](https://tabapay.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) if you need to specify a <<glossary:SubClientID>>.

params.name: AU
params.description: Use to send the card number and expiration date to network's Account Updater, and apply any card changes.

params.name: AVS
params.description:
Use if you would like to perform [<<glossary:AVS>>](https://developers.tabapay.com/docs/address-verification)

If using in tandem with `Fees` query string, append `?AVS+Fees` or `?Fees+AVS` to your URL. 

 Request to enable <Glossary>AVS</Glossary> at [TabaPay Support](https://tabapay.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new#/) or [help@tabapay.com](mailto:help@tabapay.com)

params.name: ANI
params.description:
Use if you would like to perform [<<glossary:ANI>>](https://developers.tabapay.com/docs/account-name-inquiry-ani#/)

If using in tandem with `AVS` query string, append `?ANI+AVS` or `?AVS+ANI` to your URL. 

 Request to enable <Glossary>ANI</Glossary> at [TabaPay Support](https://tabapay.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new#/) or [help@tabapay.com](mailto:help@tabapay.com)

params.name: Fees
params.description:
Use to check fees.

If using in tandem with `AVS` query string, append `?Fees+AVS` or `?AVS+Fees` to your URL.

items.docs:
Returns the attributes for the requested Payment Card.
